tools.name: web3_lookup
tools.description: Typed records by id: address, ABI, EIP. Does not search prose or rank.

tools.name: web3_grep
tools.description: Exact lexical match on a known identifier. Does not rank semantically.

tools.name: web3_search
tools.description: Ranked selectors for a prose query or unknown identifier. Does not return bodies.

tools.name: web3_deps
tools.description: Dependency closure around a selector. Does not follow calls across projects.

tools.name: web3_fetch
tools.description: Full bodies for selectors you already chose. Does not discover selectors.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "web3_fetch" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Full bodies for selectors you already chose. Does not discover selectors." → after: "Full bodies for selectors you already chose, or the next page of a cursor. Does not discover selectors."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
